items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
items.summary: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

items.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
items.summary: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

items.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
items.summary: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni's derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

items.title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
items.summary: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance's lawyers said.

items.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

items.title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
items.summary: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
items.summary: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

items.title: Palmer Luckey Says He's Building an Offshore Haven for Industry--And 'Illegal' Medicine
items.summary: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
items.summary: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.

items.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
items.summary: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.

items.title: Bitcoin Tanks Ahead of Anthropic's IPO. Should We Really Blame AI?
items.summary: Bitcoin slid toward $63,000 as Anthropic prepared its blockbuster debut. Analysts dispute whether the IPO is draining crypto liquidity, pointing instead to ETF outflows, forced selling and rising interest rates.

items.title: Senators: Treasury must ensure 'equal footing' for stablecoin issuers in GENIUS Act implementation
items.summary: Senators are pressing Treasury Secretary Bessent to grant a safe harbor for stablecoin issuers operating under state regulatory frameworks.

items.title: Binance obtains $6.5 billion freezing order from Abu Dhabi court in bid to recover stolen crypto
items.summary: Binance has obtained a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order from the Abu Dhabi Global Market Courts as it seeks to recover crypto stolen in October hack.

items.title: Ondo to launch tokenized Anthropic stock on IPO day
items.summary: Ondo's ANTon token will track Anthropic shares from the day the Claude maker starts trading on Nasdaq.

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin is back in a bearish phase but has reached a 'value zone'
items.summary: Bitcoin has dipped below its 200-day and 365-day moving averages of $72,900 and $75,900, respectively, CryptoQuant said.

items.title: Bullish's Q3 adjusted profit rises 35%, digital asset sales fall 23%
items.summary: Bullish shares rose about 10% after the crypto exchange reported earnings and authorized a buyback.

items.title: Visa Direct to extend stablecoin prefunding for cross-border payouts to Asia-Pacific
items.summary: Visa plans to let eligible Visa Direct clients in Asia-Pacific fund cross-border payouts with stablecoins.

items.title: Strategy's STRC stock crashes to $95 despite promise of 44 years of dividends
items.summary: Strategy's (formerly MicroStrategy) STRC stock plunged to its lowest level since August on Wednesday despite the company's multibillion-dollar repurchase campaign. The Michael Saylor-led company's preferred shares fell to $95.51 before recovering to $96.16, according to Strategy's data.

items.title: Coinbase AI blocks $4.7 million scam, but a simple lie exposes its weakness
items.summary: A Coinbase executive said a customer abandoned a $100,000 transfer after a warning, then talked the agent into allowing a $5,000 payment.

items.title: Germany moves to freeze Bitcoin for up to 180 days, even without access to private keys
items.summary: An exchange could block withdrawals it controls under the Bundestag-backed bill, while serving an order on a self-custody holder would leave signing keys in place.

items.title: Backpack's US approval could threaten offshore exchanges' grip on crypto futures trading
items.summary: The CFTC orders establish a U.S. exchange and clearing route, while launch terms will determine which overseas orders U.S. traders can reach.

items.title: What will OpenAI's new outside safety evaluator tell the public?
items.summary: The four-month pilot lets Apollo Research say what OpenAI withheld and explain whether redactions affected its conclusions.

items.title: Bitcoin options flash warning as downside premiums surge ahead of Fed minutes
items.summary: The gap between put and call implied volatility widened faster for Nov. 19 and 20 than for Nov. 27 over four hours on Deribit.

items.title: Payward, the owner of crypto exchange Kraken, is buying its CEO's venture capital business, Tribe
items.summary: Sethi, who was appointed co-CEO of Kraken in October 2024, is also the chairman of Tribe Capital.

items.title: A $1.5 billion crypto startup is taking on Hyperliquid with a Wall Street playbook
items.summary: Variational and its investors are betting that the future of onchain trading will look more like a traditional brokerage than a crypto exchange.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn't double as the vault
items.summary: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it.

items.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
items.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

items.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
items.summary: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans
items.summary: The bitcoin miner is taking on borrowing tied to an Ohio power plant as it shifts more of its business toward AI infrastructure.
